name: Aigburth
source: The player character Aigburth, or Aiggy, is the youngest member of XIX. Cheerful and a little sheltered, Aigburth starts the game out with no clear defined persona. It's the player's job to make sure he has a place to shine in the boy band. Will he be a breakout sensation, or will he resign himself to the fate of being "that third one"?
